principle: Use shared context to choose the best surface intelligently. Reuse canonical surfaces when that is simpler, but do not block a better architecture when a new surface has a concrete advantage.

coordination.rule: Inspect current main, open PRs, Context Hub and the shared ledger before duplicating a capability. Shared state guides judgment; it does not act as a permission gate.

installablePwas.name: Héctor OS
installablePwas.purpose: Main personal OS, chat, general controls, shared utilities and entry point.

installablePwas.name: Héctor Agent
installablePwas.purpose: Autonomous goals, task execution, approvals, activity, checkpoints and Agent controls.

installablePwas.name: Pendientes
installablePwas.rule: Keep unrelated work out of this PWA. Work explicitly targeting Pendientes may change it normally.

sharedSurfaces.rule: Bridge and Bridge Core currently form one capability layer. Extend or split only when evidence shows a real architectural benefit.
Context Hub is the shared context layer. UI normally belongs in an existing owner surface, but a different architecture is allowed when justified and recorded.

creationRules: Before creating a PWA, inspect shared context and existing surfaces so the decision is informed rather than accidental.
Reusing an existing surface is preferred when it is the simplest coherent solution; it is not mandatory when separation has a concrete advantage.
If a new installable PWA is created, update this registry in the same change so other agents immediately inherit the new architecture.
Never create overlapping service-worker scopes or cache ownership across PWAs.
Do not modify Pendientes for unrelated work.
Never use this registry as a hard permission gate. It is shared architectural state and must evolve when the system evolves.
